lines.say: The donkey works harder than the lion.
lines.show: The donkey works *harder* than the lion.

lines.say: So why isn't the donkey king?
Society says the hardest worker wins.
But across 88 studies, practice explained only 12% of the difference in performance.
lines.show: But across #88 studies, practice explained only *#12%* of the difference in performance.

lines.say: Hours matter. How you use them matters more.

lines.show: A lion rests most of the day. It *watches.* It *waits.* Then it *strikes.*
